questions.question: What does spatial mean pooling discard in this classifier?
options: The exact location of local responses
questions.explanation: Pooling summarizes each feature channel over positions. This can support orientation classification, but it cannot preserve exact bar coordinates.
optionFeedback: Pooling summarizes each feature channel over positions. This can support orientation classification, but it cannot preserve exact bar coordinates.
A mean over spatial axes preserves the channel axis. Inspect which axes disappear from the output shape.
Convolutional channels can encode orientation responses before pooling. The direct information lost here is the exact spatial arrangement.
